responsibility: This definition module declares the generic dynamic indexing container used throughout mc for storing arbitrary ADDRESS values by CARDINAL index. It defines the abstract Index type and the public operations for creating, resizing, querying bounds, inserting, deleting, deduplicating, and iterating indexed entries, making it the interface layer for mc’s reusable pointer-array abstraction rather than any parser- or AST-specific logic.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the public Modula-2 interface for the Indexing stem: it declares the opaque Index type and exported index operations, while the same-named .mod file provides the backing record layout, allocation/reallocation logic, and element-moving implementation.
